ahead of the player (the door starts this event).

Shh, this is my only break before tonight.

Lady Pairin tears them up like a cat clawing silk.
A calico cat, staring at the stove

the ladies come down. Not too hot, not too cold.

Every night the guests bring mud in on their shoes,
and every morning I sweep it up.
Lady Pairin danced barefoot last night.
If she cuts her foot, I'll be the one in trouble!
Tonight Lady Pairin dances to "Willow by the Water."
I can't miss the high note again.

every wrong note. Every single one.
